hero.title: Sri Lanka's Fruit Farm, Rooted in Jaffna
hero.description: From our Jaffna farm in Sri Lanka, we cultivate fresh fruits, natural dairy products, and farm-made beverages crafted with quality and care.

about.headline: Our Story
about.p1: Thooddakkaaran, which means "the one who tends the garden" in Tamil, was built on a straightforward idea: Sri Lanka deserves premium-quality fruits and natural products grown right here on our own soil.
about.p2: Based in Jaffna, Northern Province, we cultivate pomegranates, dragon fruit, watermelon, and guava using sustainable farming practices that respect both the land and the people who work it. What started as a farming operation has grown into something broader — a trusted agricultural brand with its own line of natural products including pure cow ghee, drinking yogurt, and freshly pressed pomegranate juice, all crafted from the fruits and produce of our own farm.
about.p3: We work with wholesale buyers, retailers, hotels, individual consumers, and fellow farmers across Sri Lanka. Whatever your need — whether it is a weekly fruit order, a bulk supply agreement, quality saplings, or expert farm consultation — Thooddakkaaran is your partner from the ground up.

services.headline: Expert Support for Sri Lankan Farmers
services.intro: Thooddakkaaran is more than a fruit farm. We work closely with farmers across Sri Lanka, sharing our knowledge, saplings, and hands-on experience to help you grow premium fruits successfully and sustainably.

consultation.title: Farm Consultation
consultation.description: Guidance for farmers starting or improving pomegranate, dragon fruit, or guava cultivation. Available on-site in Jaffna and remotely across Sri Lanka.
items: Irrigation planning for dry and intermediate zones

saplings.title: High-Yield Sapling Supply
saplings.description: We supply high-quality saplings from our Jaffna nursery, selected and grown to suit Sri Lanka's climate and ensure reliable yield.
items: Grafted saplings for faster fruiting and consistent yield

sustainable.title: Sustainable Farming Practices
sustainable.description: We help farmers build healthier soil and reduce reliance on chemicals using practical, field-tested methods.
items: Drip irrigation guidance for water efficiency

cropManagement.title: Crop Management Support
cropManagement.description: Ongoing support from planting to harvest, so you are never managing your farm alone.
items: Custom crop calendars based on region
Monthly farm visits (Jaffna and nearby areas)

products.headline: From Our Jaffna Farm to Your Table
products.intro: We grow premium fruits and craft natural dairy and beverages with ingredients from our own farm — no artificial additives and no compromise on quality.
products.ecommerceNote: This is the official Thooddakkaaran website. Supply, wholesale, and product enquiries are handled by our team by phone, email, or WhatsApp. A dedicated retail e-commerce site is planned separately — we'll link it here when it is live.
products.fruitsIntro: We grow four premium fruits on our Jaffna farm, each variety chosen for its suitability to Sri Lanka's dry-zone climate and its demand among buyers across the island. Every fruit is hand-harvested, graded, and supplied directly from our farm, with no middlemen and no long cold chains.

pomegranate.title: Pomegranate, Our Signature Harvest
pomegranate.description: Jaffna's dry, sun-rich climate produces pomegranates with exceptional sweetness, deep ruby-red arils, and thick skin that travels well. Our pomegranates are available for wholesale bulk supply, retail packaging, and direct home delivery across Sri Lanka.

dragonFruit.title: Dragon Fruit
dragonFruit.description: We cultivate dragon fruit suited to Sri Lanka's tropical conditions. Increasingly popular among health-conscious consumers, hotels, and juice bars, our dragon fruit is vibrant, fresh, and supplied directly from our farm.

watermelon.title: Watermelon
watermelon.description: Grown under Jaffna's warm sun and open skies, our watermelons are naturally sweet, juicy, and refreshing. Ideal for supermarkets, fruit vendors, hotels, and bulk seasonal supply, each harvest is carefully cultivated for freshness and quality.

guava.title: Guava
guava.description: Our farm-grown guavas are rich in flavour, naturally aromatic, and packed with nutrients. Harvested fresh and supplied directly from our fields, they are perfect for retail markets, juice shops, and health-conscious consumers across Sri Lanka.

products.naturalHeadline: Natural Products Crafted from Our Own Farm
products.naturalIntro: Everything we make starts on our farm. Our branded product range includes pure cow ghee, drinking yogurt, set yogurt, curd, and freshly pressed pomegranate juice, all crafted using farm-sourced ingredients with no artificial additives, and no compromise on quality.

setYogurt.title: Set Yogurt (80g)
setYogurt.intro: Prepared using fresh milk and natural fruit flavours, our 80g set yogurts offer a rich texture and satisfying taste in convenient individual portions — ideal for school tuck shops, supermarkets, hotel buffets, and daily consumption.

drinkingYogurt.title: Drinking Yogurt (200ml)
drinkingYogurt.intro: Our drinking yogurts are light, refreshing, and crafted without artificial thickeners or flavour enhancers. Available in a variety of flavours, they are perfect for everyday refreshment, cafés, canteens, hotels, and retail outlets.

fruitDrinks.title: Fruit Drinks (200ml)
fruitDrinks.intro: Made for everyday refreshment, our fruit drinks are crafted using carefully selected ingredients and natural flavours without artificial colouring. Convenient, refreshing, and suitable for all age groups.

cordials.title: Cordials (500ml)
cordials.intro: Our 500ml cordials are concentrated fruit beverages designed for home use, restaurants, catering services, and hospitality environments. Enjoy rich fruit flavour in every serving.

products.dairyIntro: Our dairy products are crafted from fresh cow's milk using traditional preparation methods and carefully maintained quality standards. Fresh, natural, and trusted for everyday use.

curd.title: Curd
curd.intro: Fresh, thick curd prepared for daily meals, hospitality use, and retail supply.

ghee.title: Pure Cow Ghee
ghee.intro: Traditionally slow-cooked pure cow ghee with a rich aroma and golden texture — prepared without vegetable oil blending or artificial additives.

paneer.title: Paneer
paneer.intro: Fresh paneer made from cow's milk with a firm texture suitable for a variety of cooking applications.

products.ctaIntro: Get in touch for availability, wholesale pricing, or any question about our range. We supply and deliver across Sri Lanka.

why_choose.headline: Why Choose Thooddakkaaran
why_choose.intro: Quality from our fields, transparency in our process, and dependable supply for partners across Sri Lanka.

expertise.title: 40+ Years of Farming Expertise
expertise.desc: Generations of experience in agriculture and food production allow us to understand quality from the root level. We bring traditional knowledge together with modern practices.

integrity.title: Farm-to-Product Integrity
integrity.desc: We grow and source many of our ingredients directly, ensuring full control over freshness, hygiene, and natural quality from start to finish.

fresh.title: Naturally Fresh & Hygienic Production
fresh.desc: Every product is carefully processed under strict hygiene standards to maintain purity, taste, and nutritional value without compromise.

trusted.title: Trusted by Local Communities
trusted.desc: Our products are widely trusted by retailers, distributors, and families who value consistent quality and authentic taste.

supply.title: Reliable Supply & Distribution
supply.desc: We ensure timely delivery and stable supply chains, supporting both small businesses and large-scale distributors efficiently.

stats.headline: Supporting Farmers Across Sri Lanka
stats.intro: Empowering farmers with modern agricultural knowledge, high-quality plants, and sustainable farming solutions.

vision_mission.headline: Our Purpose for Growth
vision_mission.intro: We are committed to building a strong agricultural future through trusted farming, quality produce, and sustainable practices in Sri Lanka.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To build a trusted agricultural brand that delivers purity, supports farmers, and promotes sustainable farming for future generations.
